claims.label: Summary
claims.explanation: HB 239 would automatically apply municipal firefighter and police civil service requirements to municipalities with at least 25,000 residents and a paid fire or police department, without an adoption election. It would require sheriff's departments in counties with at least 250,000 residents to adopt civil service; newly covered municipalities and counties would have to implement the applicable system. Qualifying municipal employees with more than six months of service would receive the specified civil service status, and employees whose primary duties are municipal emergency medical services would be treated as firefighters under the chapter.
Changes civil service requirements and implementation duties for qualifying municipal and county governments.
